rationale: The full master/union/candidate/lead graph and existing historical identity/membership and source references allow a lossless reference-based handoff definition. A naked union is insufficient, but no second source of truth or mandatory destructive schema rewrite is required. Native proof enrichment, context/horizon admission and concrete read-only consumer binding are not implemented or registered. Missing proofs block individual requests, not falsely label the contract operational.

identity.serialization: app.fundamentals.diagnostic_comparability.canonical_json and content_fingerprint; UTF-8, sorted object keys, explicit arrays, UTC aware timestamps, Decimal strings, no NaN
identity.timestamp_normalization: datetime.astimezone(UTC).isoformat(); semantically equivalent timezone representations equal; naive rejected
identity.formula: K = content_fingerprint({contract_id, contract_version, canonical_security_id, inspection_as_of, inspection_context}); inspection_request_id = 'brain-inspection-request:' + K without 'sha256:'
identity.fingerprint_formula: F = content_fingerprint(entire normalized handoff payload excluding only handoff_fingerprint). Include inspection_request_id and all source/union/candidate/origin/context/policy references, their native fingerprints, null/unavailable states and reasons. No fingerprint repairs.
identity.collection_order: Origins sorted by (funnel_id, lead_id, native_fingerprint); lineage by (kind, reference_id, native_fingerprint, known_at); context/native proof refs and reasons sorted by their stable IDs/content. Exact duplicate references follow native replay semantics; conflicting references reject. Native original payload/fingerprint retained unchanged.
identity.native_fingerprint_normalization: Native manifest_fingerprint may be bare64 while content_fingerprint uses sha256:. Retain native encoding and verify with native function; never strip/re-hash a source to turn tampering into valid evidence.
identity.extra_fields: Closed listed schema; no arbitrary decision, score, price, size or action fields accepted.

replay.same_key_same_fingerprint: IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY; one logical inspection; do not re-run61
replay.same_key_different_fingerprint: BLOCKED / DUPLICATE_REQUEST_AMBIGUOUS; retain both complete submitted snapshots and conflicting fingerprints; no first/last winner and no second diagnosis
replay.later_origin: NEXT_EXPLICIT_INSPECTION_CUTOFF_ONLY. Do not append to or recalculate an old request. A later canonical batch at an independently supplied strictly later I may define a new request with optional prior_request_reference, retaining old request and all new origins. A different union alone at the same I/context cannot create another evaluation.
replay.no_loss_on_rejection: Invalid/no-request receipts retain original source identifiers/fingerprints and full supplied immutable source reference set; malformed unsafe identifiers use stable error and no fabricated request ID. Storage/receipts implementation is deferred.

temporal.D_i: origin.lead.discovery_as_of; source observation cutoff, not a newly claimed physical detection or event timestamp
temporal.U: source_union.as_of == source_candidate.batch_as_of; effective union cutoff, not physical formation time
temporal.I: explicit inspection_as_of; neither trade decision/execution nor setup-entry timestamp
temporal.required_order: native source observed/publication/receipt/known/effective clocks (where required by source) <= D_i <= U <= I; native validity must also hold at I for admission
temporal.universe_rule: membership/identity known and effective at each D_i and I; master U-visible membership alone does not prove membership at earlier D_i; use retained earlier native records, never current backcast
temporal.native_endpoint_semantics: HistoricalSecurityIdentity.eligible_as_of and BacktestLookaheadGuard.membership use inclusive end when present; preserve native source-specific semantics, no generic interval conversion
temporal.strict_pit: Requires all deep canonical evidence admitted by native PIT/effectivity/knownness at I. Current technical snapshots are never historical proof.
temporal.current_descriptive: An explicit separate requested temporal mode, never an automatic fallback from STRICT_PIT; every current-descriptive result retains limitations and cannot feed historical/scenario authority

state_reuse: DiscoveryFunnelId, source layer/horizon/readiness/quality/reference enums and CandidatePoolStatus remain native. Listed handoff states/reasons are governance vocabulary only, no new runtime enum introduced.

failures.condition: Unknown/malformed structure, forbidden execution fields, unsafe ID or non-finite value
Native union/candidate/lead/source fingerprint fails; no recompute/repair
Same logical inspection key with different immutable content
Missing/ambiguous exact NSE ISIN identity or conflicting identity/lifecycle records
No exact source-proven membership at each D_i and I
Context-only funnel emitted as ordinary whole-market origin, even alongside valid origins
Wrong exchange/segment/security type or native universe ineligible; no new classifier
Any retained origin or required source metadata after its cutoff; no hiding among valid origins
Strict request paired with current-descriptive-only deep evidence; no mode conversion
Missing source ID/fingerprint/version/knownness or source-native verification
Module/funnel version alone does not establish actual source producer contract version
Required admitting trigger has no governed freshness/applicability proof at I
No integrity-valid, temporally valid, policy-eligible ordinary origin
An otherwise admitting required trigger is stale under its own source policy
Separate consumer state, never changes candidate proof into actual delivery
Partial/unavailable source family cannot admit solely from registry existence
Research origin retained, cannot establish admission or change qualification

failure_policy: Validate schema/integrity first; collect every safe applicable reason in stable sorted order. Primary candidate state uses failure_order. Per-origin admission exclusions retain their reasons/complete origins; they do not mask malformed/future/conflicted data. No valid origin, missing required proof or stale admitting origin blocks submission. Consumer state is independent; effective dispatch is BLOCKED unless candidate ready AND exact consumer binding ready. Current submission_state is always NOT_SUBMITTED.

freshness.rule: Every integrity-valid potential admitting origin needs its approved source freshness/effectivity proof at I; stale required trigger -> STALE_TRIGGER, absent proof -> INSUFFICIENT_PROVENANCE, conflict -> BLOCKED. Non-admitting research context retains unknown/stale labels and never supplies admission or a downstream fact.

context.context_attachments: Separately supplied, exact PIT/native-fingerprint-bound references only. MARKET_DISLOCATION may accompany a valid ordinary candidate as regime context; it cannot satisfy origin eligibility. Holding/watchlist context requires a separately approved contextual binding; unsupported in this market-wide contract. Do not reclassify/prune an invalid contextual union origin into a harmless attachment.

consumer.shared_brain: app.intelligence.shared_brain_application.SharedBrainApplicationService.analyze_stock -> build_shared_brain_production_snapshot; stored evidence composition, not automatic runner invocation
consumer.governance: Use canonical typed runner authorization/definition and native approval/selection/effective-time verification; optional runner governance must not be silently omitted for production. Handoff contract ID is not a strategy ID.
consumer.deep_assembly: Independently load and validate canonical observations, financial/technical/benchmark/research wrappers and governance at I. Exact security/as_of; provenance refs may seed lookup but cannot substitute for deep data or governance.
future_binding_must_prove: security-level idempotency before one runner call
canonical typed diagnostic authority at I
all61 output correlation; missing diagnostics remain insufficient
no database writes, scheduler, provider, portfolio or broker authority from handoff

radar.input: CanonicalDiscoveryLead + explicit evaluation_as_of + CanonicalDiagnosticHorizon + injected assembler/runner
radar.dedup: lead_id; distinct leads for same security evaluated separately
radar.native_horizon: Explicit member of CanonicalDiagnosticHorizon also supported by lead; union horizon_lineage is not a selected horizon
radar.active_family_gate: Exact registry/version and OPERATIONAL source state; not generic research promotion
radar.required_change_later: Security-level wrapper/consumer binding required. Do not loop all origins, choose a first winning lead/horizon, synthesize a fake lead representing union, or call old bridge as strict-historical proof. Reuse Canonical61/evidence/result validation concepts, not a second61 engine.

correlation.rule: Reference the exact immutable request fingerprint used, not merely logical ID. Preserve source+deep lineage; subsequent score/setup/gate/Watch artifacts may reference this existing lineage only when actually evaluated. No success states or result IDs fabricated at handoff.

pending_gate1.reason: The predecessor deferred CAS for one shared handoff-contract slice; that definition now closes. CAS is independent source recovery and remains the next frozen work item. Binding prerequisites are recorded, not falsely solved or allowed to indefinitely displace this accepted child.

next_scope: Resume only the previously frozen official CAS security-membership and close-source recovery scope, preserving the accepted session/price audit, all authority/parameter states and this handoff contract. Do not combine it with consumer wiring, live diagnosis or funnel promotion.
